pricing.source: Verified 2026-11-04 against docs.anthropic.com pricing (Sonnet 5 = $2/$10 per MTok, cache read $0.20, 5-min cache write $2.50) and the repository's ai_pricing.py, which is the same table record_api_usage bills against. Sonnet 5 max_output_tokens raised from a stale 8192 pin to the documented 128000 on 2026-11-16 (bundled claude-api reference 2.1.322, models.md); request ceilings stay at most 20000 (pipeline_config.AI_TOKENS_MAX). Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 base rates were already correct; their cache rates now use ai_pricing.py's 0.1x/1.25x multipliers.
